latin: Non est sub eadem specie angelorum plurificatio.

mentions.context: we are still left with one substance only and with one dimension of a body.91 Since this thesis is included among the theses criticized by Bernardo Torni, we shall discuss it again and with further detail in Chapter 12. Thesis 21 brings us again to angelology. It states that there can be no pluri- fication (that is, differentiation into many instances) of angels in the same species.92 This is discussed in Thomas’s commentary on the Sentences, 2, d. 3, q. 1, a. 4.
